optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Wealth Services Platform
professionalSummary: Maintains a month‑end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing coefficients quarterly from platform job‑history tables.
Plans compute and storage capacity for each month‑end cycle in collaboration with the platform team, translating forecasts into node reservations and storage headroom.
Reduces month‑end batch overruns, achieving a drop from 9 to 2 overruns per cycle over six cycles.
Coordinates capacity changes with platform and finance teams, securing approvals and cost sign‑offs.
Documents model assumptions, known limitations and hand‑over items for each planning cycle.
experienceHighlights: Maintained the month‑end demand model and refreshed coefficients quarterly.
Planned compute and storage for each month‑end cycle with the platform team.
Reduced month‑end batch overruns from 9 to 2 per cycle over six cycles.
Coordinated capacity changes with platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review.
Wrote assumptions notes for each planning cycle, detailing coefficients, limitations and hand‑over items.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: overrun report extract for six cycles and assumptions note for one cycle, with export identifiers as verification trail.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The resume and work sample establish the candidate’s responsibilities, actions, and outcomes for the capacity planning role, but do not provide independent external verification beyond the provided notes.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate has evidence for all listed requirements but further verification is recommended.

role.roleTitle: Capacity Planning Analyst, Wealth Services Platform

evidence.text: Maintained the month-end demand model that forecasts batch volume from client, account and report counts, refreshing the coefficients each quarter from the platform's job-history tables.
Planned compute and storage for each month-end cycle with the platform team, translating the forecast into node reservations and storage headroom in the capacity plan.

Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 per cycle to 2 per cycle over the six cycles after the re-sequenced valuation jobs went live, as recorded in the platform's overrun report against its published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle for the preceding half-year.

Coordinated capacity changes with the platform and finance teams in the monthly capacity review; reservation changes were approved by the platform manager and the cost impact was signed off by finance.

Wrote the assumptions note for each planning cycle, listing the model coefficients, the known limitation that ad-hoc adviser reports were outside the forecast and the hand-over items for the next cycle.

supportedClaims.claim: Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 to 2 per cycle over six cycles.
supportedClaims.witness: Month-end batch overruns fell from 9 per cycle to 2 per cycle over the six cycles after the re-sequenced valuation jobs went live, as recorded in the platform's overrun report against its published baseline of 9 overruns per cycle for the preceding half-year.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify overrun figures with platform manager (source src_f2de23de9172).
Confirm that capacity reservations were approved by platform manager and cost impact signed off by finance (source src_34e8652e2e3f).
Confirm that the re-sequencing of valuation jobs was indeed the candidate’s proposal (source src_f2de23de9172).
Ensure that the assumptions note includes all required model coefficients and limitations (source src_1747624ed4c1).
hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The candidate’s resume and work sample provide comprehensive evidence that they meet all functional requirements for the Capacity Planning Analyst role, including forecasting, capacity planning, overrun reduction, coordination, and documentation. All claims are directly supported by the provided sources. However, independent verification of key metrics (overrun reduction, approval records) is recommended before making a hiring decision.
limitations: Evidence is limited to self-reported resume and internal notes; external verification of metrics and approvals is required.
